Alyssa (AE): FYI - LumenAxis CISO pushed back on our standard SQ. they insist on customer-managed keys + HSM attestation before any POC traffic. POC is paused.
Mike (Solutions Eng): ack. do we have a standard attestation doc or do we need custom?
Sara (Security): we have a BYO-KMS checklist but not a customer-facing attestation PDF. two feasible routes: 1) stand up Private with direct KMS integration (we can demonstrate HSM usage) or 2) provide a security attestation stating our Dedicated/Private integration meets FIPS/HSM requirements. both need legal signoff.
Jon (Platform Eng): technically spinning a Private test instance in eu-west-1 and wiring their KMS over VPN is straightforward. estimate 36-48 hours if infra gets priority.
Priya (Sales Lead): customer wants decision within 72 hours. we should escalate. proposing exec bridge with CISO + our Security Lead tomorrow AM.
Alyssa (AE): propose 9:30am PT. I'll send invite once Sara confirms.
Sara (Security): I can join. I'll draft the attestation template and redline language for the SQ.
Mike (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a short tech brief with network diagram + key-flow and attach to the invite.
Legal Bot: Reminder: any attestation with "guarantee" language needs counsel review. suggest limiting to "we can demonstrate" and include the BYO-KMS runbook link.
Alyssa (AE): tagging customer asks: please prepare a short list of artifacts to request pre-bridge:
 - HSM model + FIPS certificate PDF
 - Temporary test principal/service account for handshake validation
 - Network egress/IPs for VPN/peering
Mike (Solutions Eng): sample sample KMS snippet we can show (scrubbed):
```
resource "kms_key" "customer" {
  origin = "EXTERNAL_HSM"
  residency = "EU"
  usage = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT"
}
```
Jon (Platform Eng): ops note: we'll need a short downtime window for cert handshake testing if they require mutual TLS. add 30-60 mins buffer.
Priya (Sales Lead): flagging pricing: Dedicated/Private will change the deal economics. Finance needs a heads-up; Alyssa add FYI on the invite.
Alyssa (AE): will do. action items: Sara draft attestation + legal phrasing; Jon prep deployment ETA + ops sketch; Mike tech brief for CISO; Alyssa schedule bridge and request artifacts; Priya coordinate customer execs and cc finance.
Alyssa (AE): I'll update here after invite goes out. if anyone can't make the proposed time, DM me and we'll shift. :thumbsup:
